question: ARB vs OP: larger % price change on July 26, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Arbitrum (ARB)": Wins if the absolute percentage price change of ARB/USDT on Binance over July 26, 2026 (UTC 00:00 open to UTC 23:59:59 close) is strictly greater than that of OP/USDT over the same period.
- "Optimism (OP)": Wins if the absolute percentage price change of OP/USDT on Binance over July 26, 2026 (UTC 00:00 open to UTC 23:59:59 close) is strictly greater than that of ARB/USDT over the same period.

Clarifications:
- Percentage price change is calculated as |( close_price − open_price ) / open_price| × 100 for each token, using the daily open (00:00:00 UTC) and close (23:59:59 UTC) prices of the respective USDT pair on Binance on July 26, 2026.
- If the two percentage changes are exactly equal, the market resolves to the outcome with the higher raw absolute price movement in USDT terms (i.e., |close_price − open_price|).
